title: 54. How can I upload an existing translation to my survey?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How can I upload an existing translation to my survey.
short_answer: Open your survey and open the 'Translations' page. Click on 'Upload existing translation'. A wizard will guide you through the process of uploading the translation.
